tei:div.tei:p: 463)dag snang mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab mo las/ brda don 'brel ba rdo rje'i gad mo bzhugs so/ dus bzang nyer lnga'i nyin thun mtshams zhig la gnas tsā ri 'brug thang skyed mos tshal na bya tshogs mang po skar ltar 'tshogs yod pa'i nang 'dir khyad 'phags kyi gser bya g.yu bya gnyis yod pa 'di ni rgyud 'jam khog yangs gsar grogs med/ byang sems ldan cing chos la dad/ gnyis ka mthun pa'i yid kyis 'grogs shing phan tshun chos mthun gyi gtam 'di smras so/ gser ldan na re/ e ma/ yid mthun skal bzang g.yu bya sngon mo// rang sems bsam pa chos la thag chod// smra shes don go blang dor ma nor// skad mthun bya yi khyu tshogs mang yang*// chos sgrub bsam pa skad cig mi skye// rnam g.yeng ngang du snang ba yud tsam// 'chi ba'i rkyen ni glo bur thon tshe// 'chi chos ma 'grub rang skal chad 'dug /da ni la 'ur dam pa'i lha chos// bsgrub la brtson dang yid mthun skal bzang*// dam bca' yin no snying gi dkyil zungs/ 464)/e go e go yid mthun lha grogs// nyams len dben pa'i gnas su bskyangs na// bcos med rtogs pa ngang gis skye yong*// nyams len rtsal kha shugs kyis 'bar nas// lta ba 'khor 'das ro snyoms rtogs yong*// sgom pa gnyug ma'i rang gdangs ngoms nas// spyod pa gang byung rgya yan rang grol// gzhi med rtsa bral dgongs pa zang thal// lam snang ma 'gags sna tshogs lhun grub// 'bras bu rtog bral nam mkha'i rang bzhin// kun bzang dgongs pa logs na med do// rang byung rig pa de ka yin 'dug /yid mthun khyod kyis de ltar e dgongs/ zhes zer/ g.yu bya na re/ ki ki legs so ki ki legs so// bden no yid 'dzin snying gtam bden no// snying po med pa 'khor ba'i chos la// zhen pa bcad nas dam chos bsgrub 'gro// tshe 'di'i 'dug thabs longs spyod bsags kyang*// 'di phyi gnyis phung mi dge sna tshogs// 'chi bdag thon tshe snying po mi 'dug

/'dug sa'i skyed tshal spang ljongs yid dga'// 'grogs pa'i bya tshogs bag yangs yid mthun// bar do 'grim dus phan thogs mi gda'/ 465)/bdud rtsi'i sbrang char ro bcud ldan yang*// bar do'i tsha gdung sel thabs mi yong*// 'di don bsam nas chos lam dengs 'gro// skal ba bzang po'i gser ldan khyed kyis// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag zab mo// ki ki bdag gi rna bar thos tshe// 'khor 'das chos kun sgyu ma'i rol pa// 'dzin zhen bral ba ma bcos rnal ma// snang stong rang grol 'od gsal rig pa/ khyad chos drug ldan kun bzang dgongs pa// gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus chos kun gnyis med// rang grol ro gcig dbu ma chen po// spros pa'i mtha' brgyad bral ba stong dbyings// 'gyur med ye shes rang gdangs chen po// phyag chen rnal 'byor rtogs grol dus mnyam// ka dag zang thal skye med rang byung*// ye shes rol pa rdzogs chen gnas lugs// gang snang rang grol khyab gdal ngang du// snying grogs khyed kyis blo thag chod dang*// ngas kyang de bzhin ngang la gnas 'dug /ces zer nas bde stong ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas/ smra bas ma brjod bral gyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur nas rig 'dzin bzhi'i sa thob te bsdu dngos 466)bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad do// yang ston zla tha chung nang du bya tshogs rnams rang gnas su dengs skabs/ gser bya rgya gar du 'gro/ g.yu bya mon yul du 'gro ba'i dus su gnyis ka yid mthun gyi gtam 'di smras so/ ki ki lha grogs ki ki lha grogs// zhal gyis phyogs la spyan gyis gzigs dang*// skyabs med mgon med g.yu bya sngon mo// thag ring yul la bgrod pa'i dus su// dbang med khyed dang 'bral dgos byung tshe// sems la sdug bsngal bzod blag mi 'dug /zab mo'i dam chos gsungs pa dran dus// sdug bsngal drag po rlung nag 'tshub 'tshub// bag yangs brtse gdung yid kyis 'grogs pa'i// bya tshogs rnams dang 'bral dgos byung yang*// mi 'gyod 'dus byas mtshan nyid yin mod// yid mthun grogs bzang gser ldan khyed dang*// 'bral 'dod bsam pa yid la med kyang*// da res 'dus byas 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid// mthong thos tsam yang med par 'gro dgos// kye hud kye hud lha grogs gser ldan// sngon chad dam bca' thugs la bzung nas/

lus srog dor yang chos mthun gzhung 467)bzang*// sems la 'gyod pa med par thag chod// 'u cag 'dir 'tshogs tshong dus mgron po// bral ba'i dus tshod ston zla tha chung*// blo gtad dam pa'i chos la byas te// rtsol bral nyams len mtha' ru phyin nas// rig stong dbyer med rang rig chos sku// ka dag zang thal kun bzang rgyal sar*// bdag gzhan gnyis med grol bar smon no// zer nas yid skyo ba'i ngang du ki ki ki zer 'dug par/ gser ldan gyis smras pa/ gnas bzang tsā ri 'brug thang shod na// spang ljongs nyams dga' bya tshogs bag phebs// bsam gtan ma sgrub pa'i nyams len bogs thon// bya tshogs kun 'dus 'tshe ba kun bral// yul bzang lha gnas skyed mos tshal nas// mjal 'phrad yongs ba g.yu bya sngon mo// 'dus pa bral ba 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid// sngon byon rgyal ba'i zhal gsungs tshad ma// rtag brtan yod pa gcig kyang med pas// thugs la skyo ngal ma mdzad yid mthun// 'khor 'das chos kun sgyu ma'i rol pa// gsal stong 'gags med me long gzugs brnyan// shar grol dus mnyam chu dang 468)rba rlabs/ gzung 'dzin rag dang ma bcos so ma// dag pa gnyis ldan smra bsam brjod bral// skye 'gag 'gyur med rang rig kun bzang*// 'khor 'das chos kun gnyis med ro gcig /ka dag rtsa bral klong du rdzogs nas// dbyings ye dbyer med bde ba chen po// rang grol ye shes ngang nas skyong mdzod/ ces zer nas dgongs pa la bzhugs 'dug bya tshogs gzhan rnams kyis yid skyo ba'i gtam brjod nas rang gnas su dengs/ gser ldan rgya gar du byon/ g.yu bya yang mon yul du phebs nas gser thang bang ri'i nags khrod nas glo bur du mkha' spyod g.yu lo bkod du 'brel thogs bya tshogs rnams dang bcas te gshegs song*/ zhes pa snyoms las pa ku sa li pa'i brdzun snang mtshar gtam du bris pa dge'o// he he/ shar gyi khu byug sngon mos// sgyu rtsal byang la ngoms nas// lho yi gser gyi nyi ma// chu bya'i rta la zhon te// nges med gnas yul nyul nges// stag seng ngar ma'i sgra yis// sa gsum mtha' nas g.yos pas// lho yi nyi

469)zla'i dkyil 'khor// stabs ka gzab pa gal che// shar smad bdud sde'i dpung tshogs// byi ba'i gdong gis bsus 'ong*// me yi sde kha'i lto sbyor// myur du 'bad na bzlog nges// nged cag dam tshig mkha' 'gro// mi ring myur du 'gro dgos// dus dang dus su brda don/ khyod kyi snying la gab yod/ ces zer nas/ sa ra ni ku mi tra taḥ tha na sa ya ra ga mi: sang ga sid+dh-i dharma ka: bud+dha bha ra na ma mi: ak+ṣa ra sa ya na shrī: pra bha wa ra nirma ka: tsan tra ya na pe ta li: ra me shwa ri ki sa tsa: de dag 'byung 'gyur lung bstan zab/ ces zer yal/ zhes pa bskal pa chu phag lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug gi dgong mo dbang gi dus su yid bzhin nor bus bka' bskul phebs tshe bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// ༈ nyams 'od gsal 'dres pa'i snang ba la// bya rtsal ldan thang dkar rgod po zhig /rang gnas kyi gtar sgrom steng du 'ong*// gsung snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad zer// e e rnal 'byor dbang mo// sgra 'dzin dbang po gson dang*/ 470)/rnga yab gling nas 'ongs ba'i// 'phrul bya thang dkar nga tshor// a ma ye shes dbang mos/ khyod la ngag gsal bskur yod// shar gyi rta bdun dkyil 'khor// 'gro ba'i mun sel e nam// lho yi rgya mtsho'i nor bu// bstan pa'i srog shing e nam// nub kyi rgya stag ngar skad// dus min dus su e nam// shar smad dam sri'i cho 'phrul/ khyod la ston pa e nam// sbrul dag 'brug gnyis khyu sdeb// rang nor lon pa e nam// smon log bdud kyi bar chad// skabs skabs 'byung ba e nam// dmar po'i lcags kyus bskul na// 'khor slob 'du ba ye nam// lho yi gser gyi rgyal mtshan// mtha' rgyas 'byung ba e nam/ he he/ yos bus 'dzum mdangs ngoms dus// ma nges gnas yul 'grim dgos// de dang stabs ldan dka' na// sgyu lus dbyings su zhig 'gro// mche ldan sbrul gnyis lto 'gros// shar gyi phyogs nas bsdebs na// thabs kyi rig pas dpyod shes// shes rab mda' mo gal che// nyams grib rkyen gyis bskul nas// mi 'dod sna tshogs yod nges// a ma'i rdo rje'i tshig 'di// rnal 'byor snying la a thaṃ/

zhes zer bzhin gshog brgyangs lan gsum byas nas je mtho je mthor byas nas lho nub mtshams su 'phur 471)thal/ zhes pa ne gro rdo rje rdzong nas su kha'i ming gi 'khrul nyams so// ༈ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang*// 'khrul 'byams bdag ni 'khrul pa'i dbang du song*// sngar bzhin lus ngag yid gsum bya bral ngang*// byis pas lha khang mthong 'dra'i nyams shig shar// dbyings nas rang byung sgra ni 'di ltar byung*// hrīḥhūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes pa'i sgra 'di grags pa ni// sgra 'dzin g.yas la thim pas yud tsam gyis// snang yul thams cad gangs la nyi shar bzhin// dkar gsal 'od kyis phyi nang dbyings rnams khyab// smig sgyu lta bur thig le dpag med shar// de yi ngang la sems nyid ngal bso'i tshe// gsal byed sgo nas thig le dkar po ni// zlum 'khyil bco lnga'i zla ba tsam gyi nang*// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram gyi// phyag mtshan mtha' skor dbus su rdo rje dang*// dril bu bsnol ma'i rnam par yang yang shar// sngags sgra sgra 'dzin g.yon la lan gsum thim// snang yul thams cad nyi ma 'bum shar bzhin// dmar gsal 'od kyis phyi nang 472)dbyings kun khyab// mu tig phreng ba lta bu'i thig le shar// ngang las ma g.yos sems nyid ngal bso'i tshe// gsal byed sgo nas thig le dmar po ni// nyi ma'i snying po tsam zhig shar ba'i dbus// che mchog yab yum 'ja' tshon lta bu ru// dpal gyi chas rnams yongs rdzogs me klong bzhugs// yab kyi thugs kar khro bo'i lha tshogs dang*// yum gyi thugs kar zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams// ma 'dres 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// yig 'bru de rnams 'od mthing rnam pa ru// bdag gis smin mtshams thim pas yud tsam gyis// snang yul thams cad nam mkha' g.ya' dag bzhin// mthing gsal 'od kyis phyi nang dbyings kun khyab/ kha dog lnga ldan thig le dpag med shar// dang las ma g.yos sems nyid ngal bsos tshe// gsal byed sgo nas thig le mthing ga ni// sran leb tsam zhig dbus su rdo rje 'chang*// yab yum longs spyod rgyan rdzogs lam mer gsal// ngang las ma g.yos sems nyid ngal bsos tshe// rdor 'chang skad cig gnas 'gyur 'od lnga yi// thig le'i dbus su āḥyig mthing gsal las// 'od zer bdag gis smin mtshams thim pa

473)yis// gnas pa rtsa yi grong khyer thams cad kun// a las a mched lus nang thams cad gang*// ngang las ma g.yos sems nyid ngal bso'i tshe// lus kyi a rnams 'od zhu dbyings la thim// dbyings kyi a yig mi dmigs nam mkha'i ngang*// 'od kyi rnam par dag gi smin mtshams thim// rang lus gdos bcas zang thal 'od kyi lus// a yig dbu ma'i lam brgyud snying gar thim// dran pa yengs med nam mkha' lta bu la// dran snang chos nyid rang bzhin rgyun chad med// der 'dzin bral ba'i dran pa rang babs che// yang dag dran pa mngon gyur ye shes ngang*// gzung 'dzin dran pa rang gsal chos skur grol// 'khrul yang 'khrul te kun bzang klong du 'khrul// grol yang grol te kun bzang klong du grol// grol 'khrul gnyis med klong du sems ngal bsos// bdag ni nyon mongs dug lnga'i dbang du song*// 'khrul snang de ltar 'byung ba ci lags bsam// kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan khyed nyid kyis// bdag gi 'khrul snang dbyings su zhi bar mdzod// yon tan til 'bru tsam zhig bdag 474)la med// gzugs med rnams kyi cho 'phrul e yin snyam// 'di don gzhan gyis gzigs na thugs khrel yong*/ gsang grogs khyed la gsang yig tshul du phul// 'di las bzlog pa'i thabs shig zhu zhu zhu/ bde ba'i rdo rjes so// ༈ dus gsum mkhyen pa gsang sngags drod 'chang ba// mkhyen gzigs mnga' bdag kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang*// brtse ldan khyed kyi shes rab 'od zer gyis// bdag gi ma rig mun pa drung nas phyungs// gdod nas ma 'khrul rig pa byang chub sems// kun 'byung lhun grub sku dang ye shes bdag /rang gsal der 'dzin bral ba'i ye shes kyis// sa dang lam gyi yon tan mngon gyur tshe// bskyed rdzogs lam 'bras mngon gyur gdams zab lam// snang nyams phra ba'i 'dzin pas yul du bzung*// ye shes spyan ldan khyed kyi thugs dang 'gal// 'khor 'das dag mnyam chos sku'i klong du bshags// bzod gsol mchog gi dngos grub gdams pa stsol// sngar bzhin lus ngag yid rnams bya bral ngang*// a wa dhu ti phyi nang gsal sgrib med// kun khyab rig pa hūm̐

475)mthing rnam par gnas// yar sne spyi bo bde chen 'khor lor nas// thig le dkar po 'od kyi rnam par zhu// mar sne lte 'og thig le dmar po ni// me lce mched bzhin 'od kyi rang bzhin du// 'dus pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su hūm̐ la thim// ngang las ma g.yos sems nyid ngal bso'i tshe// zag med bde chen mchog dga'i ye shes gsal// de las 'od zer dkar dmar 'phros pa yis// rtsa gnas grong khyer thams cad 'od kyis gang*// dkar cha thabs dang dmar cha shes rab ste// dpa' bo dpa' mos rtsa gnas kun tu gang*// gnas lngar rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro rang 'dra'i yab// 'khril nas rigs kyi dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor// gzhan yang rtsa dang ba spu'i yul rnams kun// ma nges yig 'bru 'od dang 'od zer dang*// zhi khro rigs brgya 'dus pa'i sku yang snang*// rtsa gsum skyon gyis ma gos 'od kyi rtsa// oṃ dang hūm̐ dang āḥyig rnam par gsal// phyi nang med pa rang gsal der 'dzin bral// lhar snang yin zhes spro bsdu mi dmigs shing*// dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba bzhin// yid dpyod las 'das rang byung klong 476)du rdzogs// bskyed pa med de gang snang lha ru shar// snang srid dag pa rab 'byams lhun gyis grub// bsgom pa med de gang snang chos skur grol/ mi 'gyur lhun grub byang chub sems su rdzogs// thams cad chos dbyings ngang las g.yo ba med// chos dbyings ngang las rang byung ye shes rtsal// ma nges sgyu 'phrul cir yang 'char ba ni// dus gsum kun mkhyen khyed 'dra ma gtogs pa'i// gang rung dag gis go bar mi nus shing*// tha dad ris su bcad nas zhen pas bcing*// gzung 'dzin re dogs gnyis kyi sbubs su tshud// de phyir bdag gi lus nyams snang nyams dang*// sems nyams thams cad sbas gsang med par zhus// thams cad mkhyen pa khyed kyi thugs rje yis// bdag gi ye rdzogs 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur// re dogs gnyis med gang yin yin du chug

/gzhi dbyings klong nas sgyu 'phrul zad mtha' med// dus gsum mkhyen pa ye shes thogs rdug med// gegs sel bogs 'don gdams pa'i mdzod la dbang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas las lhag bka' drin can/ khyed dang skad cig tsam yang 'bral med zhu// bdag gi rjes su zhugs pa'i skal ldan la// lhag 477) bsam rnam dag rten 'brel smon lam ni// zhus lan dang pos lus nyams sprul skur smin// zhus lan gnyis pas snang nyams longs skur grol// zhus lan gsum pas sems nyams chos skur grol// smin grol rim gnyis rdzogs pa mthar phyin nas// nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i bkra shis shog /de tsam ma gtogs gsang sgo mi 'chal zhing*// blo dman 'og ma rnams kyi 'khrul pa'i gzhi// chos dbyings yum gyi bha ga'i klong du rgya/ bde ba'i rdo rjes so// ༈ gsang grogs zhes pa ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa ma thub nas grogs sbas pa la ma yin te/ nang don gsang ba chen po'i ye shes kyi yon tan thams cad mngon sum du ston par byed pa'i grogs dam par gyur pas na gsang grogs/ yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa 'jig rten dngos rdzas ji ltar bzang yang gnas skabs kyi 'dod dgu 'byung ba tsam las/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'bras dka' bas de la zer ba ma yin te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gsang bla na med pa'i 'byung gnas dam par gyur pas na yid/ spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang 478)bral ba rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang ldan cing rang bzhin sku dang ye shes yon tan thams cad thugs chos nyid kyi klong du rdzogs pas na bzhin/ thugs rje'i mdzad pa phrin las rmad du byung ba thams mang dka' ba med pa'i chos tshul sna tshogs kyis yang dag pa'i lam zab mo ma nor bar bstan cing*/ gdul bya rnams bu bzhin rjes su 'dzin cing yang dag pa'i lam rnam par grol ba'i sa la 'god par mdzad pas/ de'i phyir na mtshan brjod par dka' na'ang don gyi slad du gsang grogs yid bzhin nor bu zhes gsol ba'o/
shī la badz+ra la kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos smyo gtam yig ris su phul ba'o//
